faq: Is a private app different from a public one?
Yes. A private app is installed only on your site. It needs no Wix review and has no listing or plans, so it is quicker and cheaper to build than a public app.
Will it work with my Wix plan?
Most widgets do. Some features, such as dashboard pages or connecting a custom domain, need a paid Wix plan. We check this when we review your request and tell you before you order.
Can it use my Wix Stores or Bookings data?
Yes. We connect through Wix's own APIs, so the widget can read products, orders or bookings with the permissions you grant. We list the permissions in the scope note.

desc:
Custom Wix widgets and apps for one site add the exact feature your site or store needs when no public app does it. Ecom Swift LLC builds a private Wix app with a widget you place in the editor, installed only on your site.

## What is a custom Wix widget or private app?

A custom Wix widget is a piece of functionality you add to a page in the Wix editor, built specifically for your site. A private app is the package that delivers it: the widget, a settings panel, optional dashboard pages and any stored data. Unlike a public app, it is not listed in the App Market and does not go through public review. Only your site can install it.

## Why build something custom instead of installing an app

Public apps are designed for the average site. If your needs are specific, you end up bending your business around a tool, or stacking several apps that almost fit. Each extra app adds weight, cost and another vendor to depend on.

A private widget does one job the way you need it. A pricing calculator can use your formulas. A product finder can ask the questions your customers actually ask. A members-only tool can follow your own rules. You get the feature without carrying a dozen settings you will never use.

## How a custom widget affects your site's results

The value depends on the job. A calculator or quiz can help visitors reach a decision faster. A booking helper can reduce back-and-forth messages. A store add-on can show details that your theme does not. A members tool can save your staff time on manual steps.

A widget that fits the task usually feels more natural to visitors than a generic one, and you control the wording, the look and the data. We cannot promise sales or leads from a feature. What we do is build the tool so it works well on desktop and phone and does what you asked.

## What a good custom widget includes

- A widget that can be dragged into the Wix editor like any other element.
- A settings panel so you can change text, colors and options without code.
- A layout that works on desktop and on a phone.
- A form with input checks, so bad entries are caught early.
- Data saved in a collection when the widget needs to remember something.
- A dashboard page where you can view and manage that data.
- A connection to Wix Stores, Bookings or another business app when needed.
- Automations that react to form or order events.
- An email notice to you when something important happens.
- A short how-to page so you or your staff can use it.

## How we build it

We start with a clear description of what the widget should do and what the visitor sees at each step. Then we build the private app in a repository, install it on your site and test it on both screen sizes. You review it in your real editor and we adjust until it behaves as agreed.

The Basic package delivers one widget with a settings panel. Standard adds a second widget, a dashboard page, stored data, a form with checks and a link to one Wix business app. Premium delivers a fuller private app with more widgets and pages, event-based automation, an email notice, a handover call and a period of fixes.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Write down the steps a visitor takes from start to finish.
- Share examples of similar tools you like.
- Test the widget on your own phone before announcing it.
- Decide who will manage the data it collects.

**Avoid:**
- Asking one widget to do five unrelated jobs.
- Asking visitors for personal details the widget never uses.
- Building a custom tool when a simple built-in Wix feature already does the job.
- Editing the widget code later without a copy of the original.

## Who this is for

A store owner who needs a product finder or add-on that no app offers. A service business that wants a quote calculator on its site. A membership site that needs a tool tied to its own rules.

## What we need from you

A clear description of the feature, any formulas or content it needs and an invitation as a collaborator on the site, which allows us to install the private app. We never need your password. Your Wix plan should support the features you want, and we will tell you if something looks incompatible.
